phase_name: Add the specs/.commit-lock/ mutex to task-lock.sh

objectives.description: Refactor acquire_scope_mutex into acquire_named_mutex + thin wrapper
Refactor release_scope_mutex into release_named_mutex + thin wrapper
Parameterize acquire wait budget (5000ms scope, 15000ms commit)
Register commit-acquire/commit-release in CLI dispatch + usage string
Use distinct COMMIT_MUTEX_HELD reentrancy flag, document two-flag invariant

verification: bash -n passed; functional test in a disposable deployed-shaped scratch tree confirmed byte-identical scope-acquire/scope-release behavior, independent .commit-lock creation/removal, non-blocking cross-mutex independence, 15s timeout on contended commit-acquire (exit 2), and token-mismatch commit-release warning without removal.
